name: DäRF
aliases: Monocular Depth Adaptation for boosting Radiance Fields from Sparse Input Views
definition: A framework for robust few-shot NeRF reconstruction that combines NeRF with monocular depth estimation (MDE) through online complementary training, adapting MDE to NeRF's absolute scaling and multiview consistency while using MDE's geometry prior to regularize NeRF.
summary: DäRF is a few-shot NeRF framework that jointly optimizes neural radiance fields and monocular depth estimation to resolve depth ambiguity and inconsistency in sparse view reconstruction.
